task_retrieval_key: A 53-year-old male presented with multiple, dusky reddish nodules on the trunk, persisting for 7 years. These lesions were bilaterally distributed along the lateral sides of the trunk and had shown slight progression. The patient has a medical history of arterial hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus. There were no systemic symptoms indicating involvement of other organs. The patient did not report any specific triggers causing induction or exacerbation of symptoms. Stroking the lesions resulted in swelling, itching, and redness of the skin.
